profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Tuboscope
profile.summary: Developed, generated design specifications, built and maintained  software/firmware systems for inspecting oil field pipe.  This work was done in coordination with hardware engineers that developed the inspection hardware. This equipment is used in pipe mills and in pipe yards to demonstrate the quality and safety of oil  field pipe Several years experience as Principle Software Engineer.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Think first, speak later. · Programming · Adjudication · Software Architecture

positions.title: Principle Software Engineer
positions.description: Supervised small staff and developed device driver firmware for flux leakage, ultrasonic, and radioactive pipe inspection machinery. Developed GUI for each of these device types to facilitate their development, prototyping and testing.
positions.insights: Skills: Think first, speak later. · Programming · Software Architecture

positions.title: Senior Programmer
positions.description: Worked on solving a program timeout problem in the user interface software of RD Tech's phased-array UT machinery.
positions.insights: Skills: Think first, speak later. · Programming · Adjudication · Software Architecture

positions.title: Senior Programmer
positions.description: Returned to Tuboscope as employee to finish out the initial build of the Truscope UT inspection system. Took over other projects related to inspection equipment. Migrated the programmers there from Borland C to Visual Studio 6 and switched programming language from C to C++. Eventually introduced VxWorks as the real-time OS for the Truscope inspection system.
positions.insights: Skills: Think first, speak later. · Programming · Adjudication · Software Architecture

positions.title: Owner
positions.description: Left Tuboscope to develop software as independent contributor. Contracted with Tanknology to develop automated tank guaging system. Returned to Tuboscope as primary software developer for the Truscope ultrasonic inspection machine and attendant GUI running under Windows 3.11. Worked a few months in Ogden, Utah for Dreco on an automated drilling rig project.
positions.insights: Skills: Think first, speak later. · Programming · Adjudication · Software Architecture

positions.title: Director of Mill and Field Engineering
positions.description: Managed drafting, mechanical and electrical engineering, and software for development of Tuboscope inspection equipment. Began new program to develop the Tuboscope Truscope UT inspection system.
positions.insights: Skills: Think first, speak later. · Programming · Adjudication · Software Architecture

positions.title: Manager of Engineering Software
positions.description: Managed programmers producing device drivers for pipe inspection equipment and programmers for developing user interface software to control and operate the inspection machines. Produced the design specifications for building this equipment. Wrote the user interface program for controlling and reporting the pipe inspection results. Started this effort using Intel's RMX real time OS. When that went away switched to LynxOs real time OS.
positions.insights: Skills: Think first, speak later. · Programming · Adjudication · Software Architecture

positions.title: Digital Systems Section Supervisor
positions.description: Supervised and contributed software for the development of Welex's first all digital, computer-based open hole logging system. Directly managed 4 technicians and 10 other engineers/programmers plus subcontractors. Developed most of the system and software specifications for this system
positions.insights: Skills: Think first, speak later. · Programming · Adjudication · Software Architecture

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description: Originally worked on defining automated, computer based system for analyzing Space Shuttle telemetry in real time. Later worked on FM telemetry system of the Space Shuttle for the approach and landing phase.
positions.insights: Skills: Think first, speak later. · Programming · Adjudication · Software Architecture

positions.title: Electrical Engineer
positions.description: Primarily worked on the real time flight test system for the B1 bomber. Was Air Force liaison officer to Grumman Data Systems for the development of the flight test system. Involved in technical specification phase and acceptance of system at Edwards.
positions.insights: Skills: Think first, speak later. · Programming · Adjudication · Software Architecture
